scope: Six rim rays, one hole ray and one exterior ray against a STEP-bridged representation of the exact 2E1 SAB from the previously joined AC1027 modeler source; plus analytic-cube ray controls. This is not independent SAB decoding or source-native placement or support qualification.

provenance.source_dwg_to_sab_join: Prior source/ODA byte-join receipt p7-ac1027-physical-modeler-acds-sab-oda-byte-join-2026-11-03.json; this audit verifies the exact previously joined SAB hash but does not repeat DWG extraction or ODA conversion.
provenance.execution: macOS ARM64 host using installed x86_64 BRL-CAD 7.24.0 under Rosetta; a scratch symlink avoids the colon in the installed application path. No tools or binaries are downloaded, modified or committed.
provenance.module_limit: Hashes bind the listed executables and major modules only; the complete OS, OCCT and BRL-CAD transitive dependency chain is not fully attested.

method: Pinned cq-acis/OCCT converts the SAB to a shape and exports STEP with pcurves disabled. This is an OCCT-processed intermediary and may already involve sewing. BRL-CAD 7.24 cannot import default pcurves and treats generic FACE_BOUND as invalid; an analytic 2×3×4 cube exhibits the same importer limitation. The audit independently parses the bounded STEP planar LINE/loop structure, validates connected rings, plane coordinates, face and bound orientations, simple nonintersecting rings, unique positive outer winding, opposite hole winding and strict hole nesting, then changes only the eight proven outer FACE_BOUND names to FACE_OUTER_BOUND. The original and normalized STEP hashes are in the report. STEPcode/openNURBS imports the normalized STEP; mged checks counts and librt/rtshot checks exact fixed-depth ray observations. A fresh scratch directory prevents output collision.

cube.note: Independent BRL-CAD ray intersection: z=2 to -2 for a central vertical ray, exterior ray misses. An earlier separate rtweight 512² run reported approximately 24.0094 mm³ versus analytic 24; this is sampled volume and is not used as a strict acceptance criterion.

solid.ray_interpretation: Six independently selected rim locations are at least 0.125 mm from either checked boundary and return distances 6 and 10 from z=10, giving z=4 and z=0. One strictly interior hole point and one exterior point miss. Printed BRL-CAD distances are not a general intersection error bound.

validation.negative_controls: A one-byte-mutated SAB is rejected by source hash before parser use. Reversing the outer STEP FACE_BOUND orientation is rejected as ambiguous winding before producing normalized output. Earlier analytic helper self-tests exercise cube, reversed hole, self-intersection, hole outside and nonplanar ring. External subprocesses have bounded timeouts; bounded input reads do not sandbox parser CPU or arbitrary filesystems.

limits: BRL-CAD receives an OCCT-generated STEP shape, not SAB or native DWG; this is a distinct geometry-kernel ray observation but not an independent decoder or separate source-native geometry oracle.
The STEP bridge omits pcurves and changes eight independently classified bound type tokens; full curve/trim interchange and nonplanar geometry are not qualified.

Retained solid-history/asmheader records remain undecoded and their effects on source geometry and placement are unproven. The observed source coordinate frame and mm assumptions are not independently tied to native DWG world placement.

An exploratory default-view 1024-grid BRL-CAD volume was 150825 mm³ versus OCCT/analytic 4243.18 mm³ with only 88 hits; a 4096² cropped run was stopped after several minutes and produced no result. These are not agreement and no source-volume claim is made.

Only selected rays and one source-associated solid are checked; REGIONs, global validity, self-intersection, native rendering, arbitrary files, platforms and whole-document replay remain open. No DWG/DXF/SAB/STEP fixture or application binary is committed.
